mapper.select: SELECT OPTION_VALUE FROM COMPANY_OPTION WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND OPTION_CODE = 'BF'
SELECT COM_RVC_RATE AS rvcRate ,COM_DE_MINIMIS_RATE AS deMinimisRate FROM COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT PL.PRD_RVC_RATE AS rvcRate ,PL.PRD_DE_MINIMIS_RATE AS deMinimisRate FROM PRODUCT_LINE PL ,ITEM_MST ID WHERE ID.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND ID.ITEM_CODE = #{productCode} AND ID.PRODUCT_CODE = PL.PRODUCT_CODE AND ID.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE
SELECT COM_RVC_RATE AS rvcRate ,COM_DE_MINIMIS_RATE AS deMinimisRate FROM FTA_MASTER WHERE FTA_CODE = #{ftaCode}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SD.SALES_NO = SM.SALES_NO AND SD.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND SD.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN MINIMAL_PROCESS_ITEM MP ON MP.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND MP.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE AND MP.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN MP.APPLY_DATE AND MP.END_DATE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = #{divisionCode} AND SM.SALES_NO = #{salesNo} AND SD.SALES_SEQ = #{salesSeq}
